mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sms_code (phone, code, type, expire_time, is_used, create_time) VALUES (#{phone}, #{code}, #{type}, #{expireTime}, #{isUsed}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sms_code WHERE phone = #{phone} AND type = #{type} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sms_code SET is_used = 1 WHERE sms_id = #{smsId} AND is_used = 0 AND expire_time > NOW()
